['Select molecule_chembl_id as chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name as compound_name, compound_structures.canonical_smiles as canonical_smiles', 'From molecule_dictionary', 'Join compound_records on molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_records.molregno', 'Join docs on compound_records.doc_id = docs.doc_id', 'Join activities on compound_records.record_id = activities.record_id', 'Join assays on activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id', 'Join target_dictionary on assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid', "Filter docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5729701'", 'Join compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno', 'Return', 'Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles', 'Limit 0']
